title: AI Disney Poster Generator
summary: Make AI Disney style posters: a 3D animated movie poster starring your own character or yourself, with the title of a film you invent. Free to try.
body_markdown:
### How do I make an AI Disney poster?


Describe an original character in one striking moment, ask for a movie poster for a 3D animated feature film with rounded shapes and big expressive eyes, then put your own title in quotes and ask for it spelled exactly as written.


### Can I make a Disney style poster of myself?


Yes. Add a clear photo of yourself as a reference image, describe yourself as the animated hero with the features to keep, such as hair, glasses and clothes, and give the poster a role and a title of your own.


### Is the AI Disney poster generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every poster on this page, costs 5 credits an image.


### Can I use Disney characters or the Disney logo in an AI poster?


Invent your own characters and titles instead. Studio characters, film titles and logos are trademarks and copyrighted designs, so an original hero with a title you made up gives you a poster you can share freely.


### How do I get the title text right on an AI poster?


Put the exact words in quotes, say where the title sits and what the lettering looks like, and ask for it spelled exactly as written, then read the result letter by letter before you share it.


### Can I make a poster of my whole family or my pet?


Yes. Add one photo per person or pet as reference images and describe each one by name, look and outfit; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### Can I turn an AI movie poster into a video?


Yes. Use the poster as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick, describe gentle motion such as wind in the hair or a kite swooping, and ask for the title to stay fixed and unchanged.
